notice: SNAP may help. DHS decides eligibility. Contact DHS or Aloha United Way 211 for assistance.

rules.summary: DHS lists a BBCE gross income ceiling of 200% of the federal poverty guidelines, no asset ceiling, and no BBCE net income test since February 2025. Disqualifications can affect BBCE. Other households face different income tests and deductions. Work requirements and household documentation also apply; this is not a complete eligibility checklist.

verification_note: Dated review of official DHS rules and outreach directory, and the AUW 211 site. Web evidence only; no phone calls placed and no availability guarantee. The SNAP landing-page link still says FFY 2026; the linked directory explicitly lists FFY 2027 effective October 2026. The directory is the source for outreach contacts and areas.
